snippet.title: Paranormal Investigation | Coldstone Update Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Play Paranormal Investigation on Steam now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602540/Paranormal_Investigation/

A psychological horror investigation where curiosity can be fatal.
You’re sent to uncover a mysterious signal coming from an abandoned facility—but what you see, hear, and miss may be your undoing.

Use cursed tools, voice-based ghost detection, and a CCTV anomaly system to locate the disturbance. Ask the ghost questions, track evidence, and dig through patient records to uncover the truth behind its death. Rooms may shift, noises draw attention, and hiding is never completely safe.

Investigate carefully. Report anomalies. Don’t let the signal consume you.
